<div class="farm-concept">
<p class="tag">The concept</p>
<h3>Data farming: the people who grow the data share in the harvest.</h3>
</div>
<div class="farm-mechanics">
<p class="farm-subhead">How it works</p>
<p>Subscribers and creators opt in, own what they generate and get paid when it is licensed</p>
<p>Enterprises buy permissioned insight into African consumers, priced to its value</p>
<p class="farm-evidence">Bluenumber, a RampRate client, has already run this model with farmers and factory workers</p>
<div class="farm-validation"><p class="farm-subhead">What we need to validate</p><p>Before scaling, we'll test how consent and data ownership would work, whether enterprise buyers will pay for the insights, and how licensing revenue could be shared fairly with the people who generate the data.</p></div>
</div>
</div>

<ul class="bul big">
<li>Define what StarNews can responsibly measure, what buyers will pay for and what delivery needs</li>
<li>Assess data, permissions, buyer needs and delivery requirements first</li>
<li>Draft an initial proposition and list the gaps to close before any market testing or major introductions</li>
</ul>
</section>
